description: Manually set (replace) the full brief for a storyline. Use to provide a human-authored brief or to push back an edited version retrieved via storyline_get. Pass the complete brief object and the current expectedVersion (use 0 when setting from scratch). After setting, call storyline_confirm_brief to advance to strategy generation.

brief.description: Full brief object — replaces the entire current brief

donts.description: Tone and style guidelines — things to avoid

dos.description: Tone and style guidelines — things to do

keyMessages.description: Core messages the campaign should communicate

links.description: Reference links (product pages, press, assets) relevant to the campaign

positioning.description: Brand positioning statement for this campaign

proofPoints.description: Evidence or credibility points supporting the campaign

toneNotes.description: Overall tone of voice guidance for this campaign

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency version from the current brief (pass 0 when setting from scratch)

name: storyline_set_brief
